name: room-editor-wall-fade
description: Verify the per-room editor walls fade to translucent (orbit-style camera-facing wall reveal) so you see into the room — the near walls fronting the camera fade, the far walls stay opaque.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: place-furniture-marker
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>/living|dining/i.test(x.id))||s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx=r.origin[0]+r.width/2, cz=r.origin[1]+r.depth/2; s.setItems([{id:'marker-sofa',defId:'sofa-3seat',position:[cx,cz],rotation:0,props:{}}]); })()

steps.name: verify-default-strength
steps.eval: (function(){ const v=window.__store.getState().wallRevealStrength ?? 0.95; if(Math.abs(v-0.95)>1e-6) throw new Error('expected default wallRevealStrength 0.95, got '+v); })()
